# matos

{matos} is an API to the [Mid-Atlantic Acoustic Telemetry Observing
System website](https://matos.asascience.com/), powered by a suite of
[httr](https://httr.r-lib.org/) and
[rvest](https://rvest.tidyverse.org/) functions.

Please note that you will need a MATOS account, [which you can sign up
for here](https://matos.asascience.com/account/signup), in order to
interface with any project-specific files.

## Installation

You can install the most-up-to-date version from
[R-universe](https://mhpob.r-universe.dev/matos) or
[GitHub](https://github.com/mhpob/matos).

R-universe:

``` r
install.packages(
  "matos",
  repos = c(
    "https://mhpob.r-universe.dev",
    "https://cloud.r-project.org"
  )
)
```

GitHub:

``` r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("mhpob/matos")
```

## Quick start

There are functions to list, download, and upload files to MATOS – check
out the vignettes for some worked examples. If you don’t want to read
and just want to get your detection files, here are the bare bones to
get you up and running:

### `list_my_projects`

Logs you into the MATOS database and pings each project in turn to see
if you have read/write access, listing those that you do.

### `list_extract_files`

Once you have a project name or number from `list_my_projects`, use this
function to list all of the files containing Ocean Tracking Network
matched detections.

### `get_extract_file`

Now that you have the URLs of the detection extract files from
`list_extract_files`, put it in here to download the file to your
computer.

## Development

As is noted above, this package is undergoing a ton of development. If
there’s something I missed, please [open an issue on
GitHub](https://github.com/mhpob/matos/issues) or [email me (Mike
O’Brien: obrien@umces.edu) directly](mailto:obrien@umces.edu).

# Package index

## Listing

Functions to list your MATOS files or projects

- [`list_extract_files()`](https://www.obrien.page/matos/reference/list_extract_files.md)
  : List OTN data extraction files
- [`list_my_projects()`](https://www.obrien.page/matos/reference/list_my_projects.md)
  : List personal MATOS projects
- [`list_project_files()`](https://www.obrien.page/matos/reference/list_project_files.md)
  : List MATOS project files
- [`list_projects()`](https://www.obrien.page/matos/reference/list_projects.md)
  : List MATOS projects

## Downloading

Functions to download your files from MATOS

- [`get_extract_file()`](https://www.obrien.page/matos/reference/get_extract_file.md)
  : Download OTN data extraction files from the MATOS website

- [`get_extract_updates()`](https://www.obrien.page/matos/reference/get_extract_updates.md)
  : Download all data extraction files that were updated after a certain
  date

- [`get_otn_template()`](https://www.obrien.page/matos/reference/get_otn_template.md)
  : Download Ocean-Tracking-Network-style metadata templates

- [`get_project_file()`](https://www.obrien.page/matos/reference/get_project_file.md)
  : Download project files from the MATOS website

- [`get_tag_search()`](https://www.obrien.page/matos/reference/get_tag_search.md)
  : Search for tags on the MATOS website

- [`get_file_list()`](https://www.obrien.page/matos/reference/utilities.md)
  [`get_file_list_mem()`](https://www.obrien.page/matos/reference/utilities.md)
  [`get_project_number()`](https://www.obrien.page/matos/reference/utilities.md)
  [`get_project_name()`](https://www.obrien.page/matos/reference/utilities.md)
  [`html_table_to_df()`](https://www.obrien.page/matos/reference/utilities.md)
  [`login_check()`](https://www.obrien.page/matos/reference/utilities.md)
  [`project_check()`](https://www.obrien.page/matos/reference/utilities.md)
  [`scrape_file_urls()`](https://www.obrien.page/matos/reference/utilities.md)
  [`download_process()`](https://www.obrien.page/matos/reference/utilities.md)
  :

  Internal functions used by `matos`

## Summarizing

- [`matos_login()`](https://www.obrien.page/matos/reference/matos_login.md)
  : Log in to your MATOS account
- [`matos_logoff()`](https://www.obrien.page/matos/reference/matos_logoff.md)
  : Log out of your MATOS account
- [`matos_receiver_summary()`](https://www.obrien.page/matos/reference/matos_receiver_summary.md)
  : Create summary reports of receiver project data from the OTN data
  push
- [`matos_tag_summary()`](https://www.obrien.page/matos/reference/matos_tag_summary.md)
  : Create summary reports of receiver project data from the OTN data
  push

## Uploading

- [`upload_file()`](https://www.obrien.page/matos/reference/upload_file.md)
  : Upload files to MATOS

## Utilities

- [`matos_login()`](https://www.obrien.page/matos/reference/matos_login.md)
  : Log in to your MATOS account

- [`set_matos_credentials()`](https://www.obrien.page/matos/reference/set_matos_credentials.md)
  :

  Install your MATOS username and password in your `.Renviron` File for
  repeated use

- [`matos_logoff()`](https://www.obrien.page/matos/reference/matos_logoff.md)
  : Log out of your MATOS account

- [`skip_example_on_ci()`](https://www.obrien.page/matos/reference/CI_utilities.md)
  [`skip_example_on_runiverse()`](https://www.obrien.page/matos/reference/CI_utilities.md)
  [`skip_example_on_cran()`](https://www.obrien.page/matos/reference/CI_utilities.md)
  : Miscellaneous functions for package checking, building, and CI
